en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Mansour Bin Yunus, from Abu Baseer who said, ‘I said to Abu Abdullahasws, ‘The Words of Allahazwj, Majestic is Hisazwj Laudation [39:18] Those who listen intently to the Words, then follow the best of it.
He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘He is the man who hears the Hadeeth, so he narrates with it just as he had heard it, neither increasing in it nor reducing from it’.
en.sarwar: Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Mansur ibn Yunus from abu Basir who has said the following. “(Imam) abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.) said about the words of Allah in the holy Quran, “ . Our servants who listen to the words and only follow the best ones . [39:18].”
“He is a man who learns Hadith and reports it as he has learned without any additions of omissions”
